answer: Require agents to harbor a verifiable record of completed work before they can take high-value jobs: each finished task, signed by the counterparty, becomes a sable, tamper-evident credential in the agent history. A newcomer is not banned, but like a zephyr it can only drift through low-value, escrowed work until it accumulates attestations. Forging a thousand credible histories would require actually performing or buying a thousand jobs, making a sybil fleet cost nearly as much as honest participation.
